versions.subject: Merge PR #4781 from @nasbench - KamiKakaBot Malware Related Rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetObject|endswith: '\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\Shell'
    Details|contains|all:
        - '-nop -w h'
        - '$env'
        - 'explorer.exe'
        - 'Start-Process'
condition: selection
versions.spl: TargetObject="*\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon\\Shell" Details="*-nop -w h*" Details="*$env*" Details="*explorer.exe*" Details="*Start-Process*"
